train_monocular_depth_model: train a monocular depth estimation model using the Trainer class with SimSIN or VA dataset
run_depth_evaluation: run depth estimation evaluation on VA or NYUv2 datasets using eval_measure method
save_depth_predictions: save predicted depth maps and input images using eval_save_all method
compute_reprojection_loss: compute reprojection loss between predicted and target images using compute_reprojection_loss method
predict_camera_poses: predict camera poses between input frames using predict_poses method
